what: Vol.5, night 1: the two positive controls of the volume's three deviations from the RAG Blueprint v2.6.2, and cell C1 on BEIR HotpotQA's whole corpus (5,233,329 passages): the Blueprint's default vector store, Elasticsearch 9.3.0 with the index type its server applies, against Vol.4's exact search on the same vectors
authorised_by: the design ticket of 2026-10-18 for Vol.5 (cells on the card only when the owner says start)
settings: BLUEPRINT_SETTINGS.md (every default quoted with file and line; the three deviations)

question_set.official_file: http://curtis.ml.cmu.edu/datasets/hotpot/hotpot_dev_fullwiki_v1.json did not answer on 2026-10-18 (03:04, 03:05, 03:19 +0800); the matching ran on the Hugging Face copy and is run again on the official file when it can be fetched

elasticsearch_as_shipped.compose: deploy/compose/vectordb.yaml lines 90-126: single node, ES_JAVA_OPTS -Xms1024m -Xmx1024m, security off, basic licence, not on the card
elasticsearch_as_shipped.index_type_read_back: a 9.3.0 node given a 2,048-dimension cosine dense_vector with no index_options (the Blueprint's mapping) reports index_options {type: bbq_hnsw, m: 16, ef_construction: 100, rescore_vector: {oversample: 3.0}} (path test, 2026-10-18 03:1x, read with include_defaults); read again from the real indexes

control_a.what: the query vectors of the Blueprint's own query path (rag-server 2.6.0's get_embedding_model, embed_query) with the swapped model, against Vol.4's query vectors
control_a.questions: the first 20 ids of the HotpotQA id table, sorted
control_a.rule: cosine at least 0.9999 for every one of the 20; otherwise stop (the ticket's first stop)

control_b.what: the first 100,000 passages of the HotpotQA corpus (file order) indexed twice: by the Blueprint's ingestor (uploaded as one text file per passage, batches of 500, its default split) and by es_bulk_load.py with the mapping read from the ingestor's index
control_b.questions: the first 100 ids of the HotpotQA id table, sorted
control_b.rule: mean overlap of the two indexes' top 100 at least 0.99; otherwise stop
control_b.if_slow: if the ingestor has not finished the 100,000 within 2 hours, the control runs on the passages it finished, at least 20,000, and the record says so

C1.load: es_bulk_load.py into a fresh index created with the captured mapping; vectors from the 16-bit store, proven per piece; 200 documents per request; refresh off while loading

measured.load_seconds: first request to the last piece indexed, then to the refresh
measured.memory: the Elasticsearch container's memory (docker stats) and the Docker VM's MemAvailable, sampled every 30 s through load and searches; the peak
measured.overlap: per query the share of Vol.4's exact top 10 / top 100 found in the store's top 10 / top 100: mean, lowest, queries under 0.9
measured.quality: nDCG@10 and Recall@100 of the store's run beside Vol.4's exact 0.80079 / 0.91567
measured.latency: c = 1 over the 7,405 queries, the duration of each call in the client container; p50, p99; the first ten apart

validity_gate.rule: on the 100,000-passage index of control (b) loaded by es_bulk_load.py: script_score exact search for 200 questions must give the top 100 of numpy's exact search on the same vectors, equal scores swapped apart and listed; otherwise no figure of the store is reported (the ticket's second stop)
validity_gate.why_on_the_slice: brute force over the whole index reads about 43 GB of vectors per question, more than the Docker VM holds; the slice is loaded by the same program with the same mapping. Five questions are also searched by brute force on the whole index and listed as a supplement
validity_gate.questions: the first 200 ids of the HotpotQA id table, sorted

negative_control.rule: the mean overlap at 10 falls at least 0.05 below the default query's

branches.heap: if the index cannot be built with the 1 GB heap: the error is the result; one more try with 4 GB (the only change)
branches.vm_memory: Docker VM memory at 85%: stop this corpus and record
branches.disk: under 60 GB free: no second corpus

expectation.overlap_at_100: mean between 0.90 and 0.99 (binary quantisation with a threefold rescore)
expectation.load: several hours (JSON floats, as the Blueprint sends them)
